definition: Median primary-round size per sub-layer per quarter (Appendix C venture measures).
name: Median round size by sub-layer
unpublished_reason: Not meaningful on current coverage: one to four seed-list rounds per sub-layer-quarter, so a median restates the venture strip's total and count; it needs a round source with market coverage (aifunding.me is on the read-not-ingested list; PitchBook, Crunchbase and Dealroom are paid).
why_it_matters: Round size is the price of entry to a sub-layer.
